meta.label: Rest-of-season values
meta.source: FantasyPros rest-of-season half-PPR ECR, exported 2026-09-21. ppw is points/week implied by positional rank; ppwP applies the playoff-weeks strength of schedule.
meta.note: ppw = rest-of-season value. ppwP = same value tilted by SOS PLAYOFFS (weeks 15-17), +/-10% across the star range. sos/sosP are 0-5 stars.
